observations: Darker backgrounds print better than white

configuration.method: Randoma11y source RGB pairs: dark member for ground, light member for marks and text. Land is a 16% foreground blend into the ground; muted context is a 68% blend. Black debris x marks retain a light halo. These design choices replace the earlier green prebias; no ink compensation or six-channel separation is simulated.
configuration.calibration: Unmeasured visual hypotheses; parameters are not estimates of ink loss or paper response.

antarctica_adjustment.scope: terrestrial silhouettes, coastlines, ice and attached country fills; editorial ocean backing closes the old land void
